name: TrainOrb
_intent: Holding a growing ball of energy overhead, facing the camera: feet wide and braced, both palms up under the orb; it grows and gets heavier for 3.5 s (knees sink, elbows give, the torso leans back, a growing tremor), Pulse: a sharp 3-frame push to full extension with the chest lifting, then recovery.
_reference: spirit-bomb charge, 4.0 s loop; Pulse at frame 105 (3.5000 s)
